corrected.text: We misread the record. On 2 September the House agreed, without objection, to a change of the resolution's first sponsor. Our classifier read that as the resolution itself being agreed to. It was not. H.Res. 179 remains in committee — originally "✅🏛️ Agreed to (unanimous consent)" — What's next originally read "Policy adoption (resolutions don't become law)".

whatsNext.text: In committee (Foreign Affairs); no floor action recorded

hidden.labelText: ASSUMING FIRST SPONSORSHIP - Mr. Jackson (IL) asked unanimous consent that he may hereafter be considered as the first sponsor of H. Res. 179, a resolution originally introduced by Representative Cherfilus-McCormick for the purpose of adding cosponsors and requesting reprintings pursuant to clause 7 of rule XII. Agreed to without objection.
